description: Everything about a token in one answer: safety, who holds it, liquidity, price action, whales and smart money, and news buzz, with an overall rating. ★ One of our best tools. Full token report, live: safety (honeypot, taxes, owner powers), holders (concentration, exchange/fund/locked share), liquidity (depth, locks, pools), price action, social/news buzz and smart-money signals (trade sizes, buy pressure, exchange and fund flows, whale transfers), with an overall rating and headline, in one call. 8 chains incl. Base, Solana, Ethereum. Use for a complete, live picture of one token before a decision. Instead, use `token-safety` ($0.02) for the scam check only. Answers may be cached for up to 20 seconds. Price: $0.10 USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits); failed calls are free. Paid only (not in the free trial). Try token-safety free first.

address.description: Token contract address (0x...) or Solana mint address.

chain.description: Blockchain: base, solana, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche.

name: token-report

buzz.description: 0-100 buzz score, website and socials, paid DexScreener promotion and boosts, Hacker News mentions in 30 days.

disclaimer.description: Limits of this answer; not financial, legal or security advice.

generatedAt.description: When this answer was produced (ISO 8601 time).

holders.description: Holder count, top-1/top-10 concentration, sellable top-10, supply by kind (exchange, fund/market maker, pool, locked, contract, wallet), labelled top holders.

liquidity.description: Total USD, depth rating, locked %, liquidity/market cap, top pools.

liquidityKnown.description: False when only a price was available.

liquidityUsd.description: Total DEX liquidity across all pairs; null when unknown (only a price was available), never a false $0.

pairs.description: Number of DEX trading pairs; null when unknown.

poolsAsOf.description: Present when pool data is the last known (DEX sources busy): when it was fetched.

priceNative.description: Price in the pair's quote token.

priceAction.description: Price, % change 5m/1h/6h/24h, trend, volume and buys/sells per window, buy/sell ratio, volume/liquidity.

score.description: null when the contract scan or liquidity data was unavailable

smartMoney.description: Bias (bullish/bearish/neutral), signals, exchange, DEX and fund/market-maker flows, large transfers, top traders (when available).

summary.description: Overall rating (avoid, caution, ok, unknown), one-line headline, highlights and risks.
